Make it yours — custom branding for self-hosters.

## Added

- **Custom branding via environment variables.** Rebrand featherdrop without
  touching code:
  - `APP_NAME` — replaces the "featherdrop" wordmark in the header and the
    browser-tab title with your own name.
  - `APP_LOGO` — a logo image URL (public or mounted, e.g. `/config/logo.svg`)
    that replaces the feather everywhere.
  - `ACCENT_COLOR` — a 6-digit hex colour that drives the buttons, the upload
    ring and other accents (invalid values fall back to the gold).

  The Unraid template exposes all three. Each one falls back to the default
  featherdrop look when unset, so existing installs are unchanged.
